74331-the-remains-of-the-late-mrs-richar.creator: Unknown
74331-the-remains-of-the-late-mrs-richar.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. can have no interest to any beyond. But without some few biographical notices connecting these letters and other papers, I must either have withdrawn many of them as unintelligible, or left them to be very imperfectly understood.

arxiv-2105-08681.title: Estimating entropy production from waiting time distributions
arxiv-2105-08681.creator: Dominic J. Skinner, Jörn Dunkel
arxiv-2105-08681.description: Abstract Living systems operate far from thermal equilibrium by converting the chemical potential of ATP into mechanical work to achieve growth, replication or locomotion. Given time series observations of intra-, inter- or multicellular processes, a key challenge is to detect non-equilibrium behavior and quantify the rate of free energy consumption.

arxiv-2208-06858.title: The success probability in Levine’s hat problem, and independent sets in graphs
arxiv-2208-06858.creator: Noga Alon, Ehud Friedgut, Gil Kalai, Guy Kindler
arxiv-2208-06858.description: Abstract Lionel Levine’s hat challenge has t t players, each with a (very large, or infinite) stack of hats on their head, each hat independently colored at random black or white. The players are allowed to coordinate before the random colors are chosen, but not after. Each player sees all hats except for those on her own head.

arxiv-2208-09734.title: A Multi-Head Model for Continual Learning via Out-of-Distribution Replay
arxiv-2208-09734.creator: Gyuhak Kim, Zixuan Ke, Bing Liu
arxiv-2208-09734.description: Abstract This paper studies class incremental learning (CIL) of continual learning (CL). Many approaches have been proposed to deal with catastrophic forgetting (CF) in CIL. Most methods incrementally construct a single classifier for all classes of all tasks in a single head network.

arxiv-2301-12507.title: Distilling Internet-Scale Vision-Language Models into Embodied Agents
arxiv-2301-12507.creator: Theodore Sumers, Kenneth Marino, Arun Ahuja, Rob Fergus, Ishita Dasgupta
arxiv-2301-12507.description: Abstract Instruction-following agents must ground language into their observation and action spaces. Yet learning to ground language is challenging, typically requiring domain-specific engineering or large quantities of human interaction data. To address this challenge, we propose using pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to supervise embodied agents.

arxiv-2306-07173.title: Unfolding Particle Physics Hierarchies with Supersymmetry and Extra Dimensions
arxiv-2306-07173.creator: Raman Sundrum
arxiv-2306-07173.description: Abstract This is a written version of lectures delivered at TASI 2022 “Ten Years After the Higgs Discovery: Particle Physics Now and Future”. Mechanisms and symmetries beyond the Standard Model (BSM) are presented capable of elegantly and robustly generating the striking hierarchies we observe in particle physics.

arxiv-2405-06677.title: ATG: Benchmarking Automated Theorem Generation for Generative Language Models
arxiv-2405-06677.creator: Xiaohan Lin Qingxing Cao, Yinya Huang, Zhicheng Yang, Zhengying Liu, Zhenguo Li, Xiaodan Liang *
arxiv-2405-06677.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xiaohan Lin Qingxing Cao, Yinya Huang, Zhicheng Yang, Zhengying Liu, Zhenguo Li, Xiaodan Liang *. Humans can develop new theorems to explore broader and more complex mathematical results. While current generative language models (LMs) have achieved significant improvement in automatically proving theorems, their ability to generate new or reusable theorems is still under-explored. Without the new theorems, current LMs struggle to prove harder theorems that are distant from the given hypotheses with the exponentially growing search space.

arxiv-2406-08975.title: Drift-diffusive resetting search process with stochastic returns: speed-up beyond optimal instantaneous return
arxiv-2406-08975.creator: Arup Biswas, Ashutosh Dubey, Anupam Kundu, Arnab Pal
arxiv-2406-08975.description: Abstract Stochastic resetting has emerged as a useful strategy to reduce the completion time for a broad class of first passage processes. In the canonical setup, one intermittently resets a given system to its initial configuration only to start afresh and continue evolving in time until the target goal is met.

arxiv-2410-19406.title: An Auditing Test to Detect Behavioral Shift in Language Models Thanks: This work was published at ICLR 2025.
arxiv-2410-19406.creator: Leo Richter, Xuanli He, Pasquale Minervini, Matt J. Kusner
arxiv-2410-19406.description: Abstract As language models (LMs) approach human-level performance, a comprehensive understanding of their behavior becomes crucial to avoid potential harms. While extensive initial evaluations, including red teaming and diverse benchmarking, can establish a behavioral profile, subsequent fine-tuning or deployment modifications may alter these model behaviors in unintended ways.

arxiv-2412-09755.title: Constraining inflation with nonminimal derivative coupling with the Parkes Pulsar Timing Array third data release
arxiv-2412-09755.creator: Chang Han, Li-Yang Chen, Zu-Cheng Chen, Chengjie Fu, Puxun Wu, Hongwei Yu, N. D. Ramesh Bhat, Xiaojin Liu, Valentina Di Marco, Saurav Mishra, Daniel J. Reardon, Christopher J. Russell, Ryan M. Shannon, Lei Zhang, Xingjiang Zhu, Andrew Zic, The PPTA Collaboration
arxiv-2412-09755.description: Abstract We study an inflation model with nonminimal derivative coupling that features a coupling between the derivative of the inflaton field and the Einstein tensor. This model naturally amplifies curvature perturbations at small scales via gravitationally enhanced friction, a mechanism critical for the formation of primordial black holes and the associated production of potentially detectable scalar-induced gravitational waves.

arxiv-2502-15572.title: DReSD: Dense Retrieval for Speculative Decoding
arxiv-2502-15572.creator: Milan Gritta, Huiyin Xue, Gerasimos Lampouras
arxiv-2502-15572.description: Abstract Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) generation by using an efficient draft model to propose the next few tokens, which are verified by the LLM in a single forward call, reducing latency while preserving its outputs. We focus on retrieval-based SD where the draft model retrieves the next tokens from a non-parametric datastore.

arxiv-2503-05305.title: Frequency Autoregressive Image Generation with Continuous Tokens
arxiv-2503-05305.creator: Hu Yu Hao Luo Hangjie Yuan Yu Rong Jie Huang Feng Zhao
arxiv-2503-05305.description: Abstract Autoregressive (AR) models for image generation typically adopt a two-stage paradigm of vector quantization and raster-scan “next-token prediction”, inspired by its great success in language modeling. However, due to the huge modality gap, image autoregressive models may require a systematic reevaluation from two perspectives: tokenizer format and regression direction.

arxiv-2508-02776.title: Investigation of mass substructure in gravitational lens system SDP 81 with ALMA long-baseline observations
arxiv-2508-02776.creator: H. R. Stacey, D. M. Powell, S. Vegetti, J. P. McKean, D. Wen
arxiv-2508-02776.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by H. R. Stacey, D. M. Powell, S. Vegetti, J. P. McKean, D. Wen. The prevalence and properties of low-mass dark matter haloes serve as a crucial test for understanding the nature of dark matter, and may be constrained through the gravitational deflection of strongly lensed arcs. Previous studies found evidence for the presence of low-mass dark matter haloes in observations of the gravitationally lensed, dusty star-forming galaxy SDP 81, using the Atacama Large Millimetre/sub-millimetre Array (ALMA).

arxiv-2512-06368.title: HuPrior3R: Incorporating Human Priors for Better 3D Dynamic Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
arxiv-2512-06368.creator: Weitao Xiong, Zhiyuan Yuan, Jiahao Lu, [0.25em] Chengfeng Zhao, Peng Li, Yuan Liu, [1em] HKUST
arxiv-2512-06368.description: Abstract Monocular dynamic video reconstruction faces significant challenges in dynamic human scenes due to geometric inconsistencies and resolution degradation issues. Existing methods lack 3D human structural understanding, producing geometrically inconsistent results with distorted limb proportions and unnatural human-object fusion, while memory-constrained downsampling causes human boundary drift toward background geometry.

arxiv-2601-12700.title: Improving Audio Question Answering with Variational Inference
arxiv-2601-12700.creator: Haolin Chen
arxiv-2601-12700.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Haolin Chen. Variational inference (VI) provides a principled framework for estimating posterior distributions over model parameters, enabling explicit modeling of weight uncertainty during optimization. By capturing this uncertainty, VI improves the reliability of predictions, yielding better calibrated outputs. In this work, we investigate the benefits of VI for challenging multimodal understanding and reasoning by applying the Improved Variational Online Newton (IVON), a recent VI optimizer, to fine-tuning a multimodal large language model on audio question answering tasks.

arxiv-2602-03987.title: Towards X-embodiment safety: A control theory perspective on transferring safety certificates across dynamical systems
arxiv-2602-03987.creator: Nikolaos Bousias, George Pappas
arxiv-2602-03987.description: Abstract Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a powerful tool for enforcing safety constraints in control systems, but their direct application to complex, high-dimensional dynamics is often challenging. In many settings, safety certificates are more naturally designed for simplified or alternative system models that do not exactly match the dynamics of interest.

pmc-10604922.title: Untapped potential of non-conventional rubus species: bioactivity, nutrition, and livelihood opportunities
pmc-10604922.creator: Saurav Chandra Bhatt, Bindu Naik, Vijay Kumar, Arun Kumar Gupta, Sanjay Kumar, Manpreet Singh Preet, Nitya Sharma, Sarvesh Rustagi
pmc-10604922.description: Rubus species holds promise as a valuable source of polyphenols and bioactive compounds, offering significant potential as functional food ingredients with both nutraceutical and pharmaceutical benefits. However, many edible species within this genus remain under-explored and their importance is largely unrecognized.

pmc-12444540.title: Cu Substitution on LaCu x Ni1–x O3 Perovskite Structure and Catalytic Activity for Glycerol Conversion Using Various Glycerol Feeds under Base- and H2‑Free Conditions
pmc-12444540.creator: Darine Denala, Wutthikrai Busayaporn, Wanwisa Limphirat, Sompin Mahakot, Sirirat Jitkarnka
pmc-12444540.description: Cu was foreseen by our group as a high potential promoter in the LaNiO3 perovskite catalyst for producing biobased chemicals from glycerol transformation, especially when inserted into the structure. Thus, LaCu x Ni1–x O3 perovskites were specifically synthesized and characterized to acquire geared structures and compositions for such a purpose.

pmc-12617869.title: Circulation of Herpesvirus and Alphatorquevirus DNA in each trimester in asymptomatic women pregnant with twins
pmc-12617869.creator: Tania Regina Tozetto-Mendoza, Layla Honorato, Mariane Pereira Brito, Noely Evangelista Ferreira, Iara M. Linhares, Angela Silvano, Antonio Charlys da Costa, Silvia Helena Lima, Viola Seravalli, Mariarosaria Di Tommaso, Maria Cassia Mendes-Correa, Steven S. Witkin, Simone Agostini, Simone Agostini, S
pmc-12617869.description: BackgroundData on the dynamics of Herpesviruses and Torque teno virus (TTV) in plasma from twin pregnancies are limited, despite their potential to provide insights into maternal immune status in this high-risk population.MethodsA convenience sample of plasma was obtained from 54 healthy women with twin pregnancies and no adverse outcomes.

pmc-12984693.title: From Waste to Bioactive Ingredient: Integrated Extraction, Identification, and Validation of Novel Antioxidant Peptides from Xuefeng Black-Bone Chicken Bones
pmc-12984693.creator: Haige Yang, Fanjia Kong, Lan Mo, Yanyang Wu, Aihua Lou, Qingwu Shen, Wei Quan, Lei Zhou, Meichun Li, Yan Liu
pmc-12984693.description: The valorization of poultry bone by-products into high-value bioactive ingredients aligns with the principles of a sustainable circular bioeconomy. This study established an integrated process for the production, identification, and validation of bioactive antioxidant peptides from Xuefeng black-bone chicken bones (BCB).

pmc-13191926.title: Fracture resistance of ceramic vonlays fabricated from different CAD/CAM materials restoring premolars after cyclic loading (an in vitro study)
pmc-13191926.creator: Ahmed Mabrouk AL-Mazzaly, Wegdan Abdel-Fattah, Dina Mohamed Nasr
pmc-13191926.description: IntroductionThe advancement of indirect ceramic restorations helps to establish new boundaries between conservative practices and prosthetics, thus Vonlay restorations were introduced to achieve the desired results in cases that involve the occlusal surface and extends to entire buccal surface due to either esthetic or functional considerations.

pmc-13196808.title: Gut microbiome signatures associated with iron-deficiency anemia in young adults
pmc-13196808.creator: Reham A Abd El Rahmen, Kawthar Saad Alghamdi
pmc-13196808.description: Background and Objectives:Iron is vital for both the body of the host and the metabolism of microbes. Pathogenic Enterobacteria need iron to grow and cause disease, but many good gut bacteria, like lactobacilli, do not require as much iron. Changes in the amount of iron available in the gut may therefore affect the makeup of the gut microbiome.

pmc-13349006.title: Associations between baseline level and clinical, anthropometric and behavioral changes in adults and the elderly diagnosed with hypertension and/or diabetes: a prospective cohort study
pmc-13349006.creator: Emily de Souza Ferreira, Vanessa de Souza Amaral, Lara Camargo de Oliveira, Michele Duarte Pereira, Tabata Isabely Souza Neves, Tiago Ricardo Moreira, Glauce Dias da Costa, Rosângela Minardi Mitre Cotta
pmc-13349006.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMultimorbidity is defined as the presence of two or more multifactorial diseases or conditions. In this context, the focus of this study is on arterial hypertension (AH) and diabetes, two chronic diseases with high global prevalence and incidence, whose clinical, physical, and behavioral factors must be critically analyzed over the long term, particularly within the primary care setting, where interventions are most effective and impactful.

pmc-13392015.title: Polypeptide-engineered lipid nanoparticles for mRNA delivery with limited immunogenicity
pmc-13392015.creator: Jin-Yue Zeng, Yue Zhang, Gui Zhao, Brandon Yi Loong Seow, Nithiyaa Bala Krishnan, Jin Hao Goh, Yi Yan Yang
pmc-13392015.description: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) have shown great potential for mRNA delivery, with polyethylene glycol (PEG) lipids playing a critical role in modulating particle size, stability and biodistribution. However, most PEGylated LNPs induce anti-PEG antibodies, leading to hypersensitivity and diminished efficacy upon repeated administration. Here we report hydrophilic, nonionic and biodegradable poly(D, L-serine) (pDLS) lipids as PEG-lipid alternatives in LNP formulations.
